target_customer: Fintech app developers that connect users' bank accounts through aggregators
problem: Bank connection vendors each have gaps, unsupported banks and frequent disconnections. Fuse offers one API and drop in bank picker that routes each bank to the most reliable vendor and normalizes the data.
product_category: Unified API over financial data aggregators

founders.name: Tunde Alao
previous_startups: YSplit (joint spending card app for couples, per the Launch HN post)
founders.background_notes: CB Insights lists a Tunde Alao as CEO of a Fuse; may be this company. The Launch HN post was written by a co-founder using the handle tonikami.

founders.name: Landon Vago-Hughes
founders.background_notes: YC bio calls him a fintech builder.

founders.name: Boateng Opoku-Yeboah
founders.background_notes: YC bio: aerospace engineer building control and verification systems for AI agents (later work).

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating several aggregator APIs, normalizing data models and routing by reliability is standard integration work with security and SOC 2 demands.

defensibility.rationale: The product depends on third party aggregators, which could change terms or compete directly; commenters on Launch HN worried about Plaid and aggregator collaboration.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The aggregators were the supply Fuse relied on; Teller shut its API per a migration guide that pitches multi aggregator routing. No dated source shows incumbents copying the routing layer.

market_need_then: The founders spent three years on a consumer app that required every user to link a bank account and hit unsupported banks and frequent disconnections; they claimed 15 to 16 percent fewer disconnections and large coverage gains in launch material.

branding.domain_note: Used letsfuse.com, with a 'lets' prefix, rather than fuse.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer docs oriented with self serve sandbox keys

branding.community_and_virality: The Launch HN thread had 94 points and 37 comments, some skeptical about data practices.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies named Fuse crowd search results, the footer links point to the founders' earlier YSplit pages, and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Fuse was a unified bank connection API from a New York team that had earlier built the YSplit app, in YC Winter 2019, with a reported 150,000 dollar YC deal and an unverified 4.2 million dollar seed on Wellfound. YC lists it inactive and CB Insights lists it as acquired, but neither is supported by a news source and no shutdown notice was found. The cause is not public, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: letsfuse.com returned HTTP 503. Funding: Bouncewatch shows a 150K seed on 18 March 2019 with Y Combinator; Wellfound shows a 4.2 million dollar seed with no date; CB Insights shows 1 million total. These are three conflicting aggregators with no press release, so none is verified and the 150K figure is likely the standard YC deal. CB Insights marks Fuse acquired, unverified and entity unclear. Competitors: the launch post names Plaid, MX, Teller, Finicity and Yodlee as vendors Fuse builds on, not rivals; Teller's 4 million raise was reported in January 2020, about ten months after the batch, so it is not listed. The Launch HN post has no date. The YC W19 part 2 blog post does not feature Fuse.
